primary: trace OFF fresh-container Docker E2E host perf_counter; startup/model/teardown included; observer teardown excluded

definitions.B: unmodified production entrypoint, per-page OMR, sequential sources
definitions.P: experimental 2-source prefetch after SR exits, per-page OMR
definitions.O: 1 source worker, all-pages production OMR subprocess once after SR exits and before sources; fresh same-run hash-bound handoff
definitions.C: same OMR reuse then 2-source prefetch; only if both single candidates pass advance gate

warm.cache: private identical copies of retained compiled seed; fresh process/model; OS/driver caches not flushed

cold.cache: new empty private Inductor/Triton cache each; OS/driver not flushed; first-call compile/setup separate from warm

advance_to_combination.gate: both P and O warm medians at least 3% faster than B, both paired observations improve and all source/downstream/resource gates pass
advance_to_combination.conditional_runs: C warm twice from same seed; C cold once from empty private cache; compare to the recorded B; no change to original single-candidate outcomes

quality: ordered source original/x4 predictions, decoded staff/connector masks, OMR predictions
combined/per-page base and final numbering and movement metadata
actual Phase C replay with manual first-measure 0, second-page movement reset1, third-page continuity; retain MMR outputs

resource_gates.competition: no known external GPU job; serialized suite, event inventories retained; WSL PID attribution unavailable, never assert complete OS ownership

fault_gates: OMR child nonzero cannot publish completed handoff; no serial fallback
missing/changed input, SR, prediction, incomplete manifest or wrong image must fail closed
source child failure/cancellation propagates; queued jobs canceled and active jobs joined; no final numbering publication
fault integration may replay retained SR to avoid inference solely for fault injection; never score these as E2E performance
unchanged_contract: strict equality without geometry/number tolerances; display-only OCR comments and run paths excluded as before; no threshold/model/seed/filter changes; initial failures retained
limits: small input and 2 warm repeats, 1 cold per condition; no significance/production-adoption or full-dataset accuracy claim; no full68 or production implementation; independent components not added as E2E stages
